---
name: Correction to a documented n8n behaviour
about: One of the findings in docs/knowledge/ is wrong, or right for the wrong reason
title: "[gotcha] "
labels: documentation
---

**Which finding**
Which file and which entry. A quote of the line is ideal.

**What you ran**
The node type, its settings, and what you executed. Be specific enough that someone else could
repeat it.

**What actually came back**
Paste the real output. Redact anything personal first — no URLs, emails, ids or keys.

**Your n8n version**
Self-hosted or cloud, and the version if you have it.

---

Findings in this repo are meant to be things proven by running, not things read in documentation.
If one is wrong, that is worth knowing and worth fixing. Thanks for taking the time.
